data.disagreement_analysis: The disagreement was caused by a transient API error (HTTP 400) in the qwen3 model when attempting to audit the .gitignore file, leading to an overall inconclusive verdict. The deepseek model successfully audited all files and correctly identified the package as safe.
coverage_issues: qwen3 model failed to audit .gitignore due to an API error (HTTP 400).
learnings: The audit orchestrator should handle transient API errors on non-executable files (like .gitignore) gracefully, either by retrying or ignoring them, rather than failing the entire audit when security-critical files (PKGBUILD, .SRCINFO) have been successfully verified as safe.
